newsitem.title: USA: Universal International Nov same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Universal International Nov same-store sales fall.

text.p: Universal International Inc comparable store sales fell 12.1 percent in November and were down 4.5 percent for the first 11 months of the year, the company said Monday.
Total sales for November for its Only Deals and Odd's-N-End's retail stores rose to $7.6 million from $6.1 million a year ago, the company said.
Total sales for the 11 months ended November 30 increased to $48.7 million from $38.0 million a year ago, the company said.

"November comparable store sales were adversely affected by the delay in the start of the traditional holiday shopping season due to the Thanksgiving Day holiday falling five days later this year versus last year," chief executive officer Mark Ravich said in a statement.
